audit_scope: Local repository and the SHA-pinned retry2 runtime source only; no L20 access was performed.

baseline.previous_remote_symptom: NameError: name 'validate_prediction' is not defined before the first LLM call

coverage_gap.why_143_passed_missed_the_error: The tests exercised build_retry4_source with a shortened source string and tested the canonical validator directly, but never materialized, imported, and dynamically executed the SHA-pinned retry2 runtime after transformation. The shortened fixture omitted the three legacy validator call sites.
layers_previously_verified: canonical summary boundaries and repair behavior
layers_not_previously_verified: materialization of the complete retry4 runtime from the real retry2 template
safe import of the generated runtime
resolution of globals used by DoctorAgent and MetaAgent call sites
execution of those call sites with a stub LLM
a fail-closed preflight before model construction
coverage_gap.compileall_limitation: compileall compiled the tracked generator, not the runtime text created later by build_retry4_source. Even compiling the generated text would only prove syntax; Python resolves a global function name when the call executes, so the NameError is not a syntax error.
coverage_gap.why_error_appeared_after_qwen_load: The generated program constructed DirectTransformersClient at module execution before run_one reached the first DoctorAgent validation call. No preflight imported or exercised the generated call graph before client construction.
coverage_gap.required_pre_model_detection: Materialize the complete runtime, py_compile it, import it without invoking its main function, resolve and inspect all validator callbacks, and execute the real generated DoctorAgent/MetaAgent path with a synthetic stub client before allowing model construction.

runtime_generation.previous_generation_method: The launcher read retry2 source text, applied guarded exact/regex substitutions, then compiled and executed the resulting in-memory string with exec.
runtime_generation.current_generation_method: The launcher SHA-verifies the complete retry2 template, applies guarded transformations, writes an import-safe final runner and generation manifest, runs a fail-closed compile/import/callback preflight, and only then executes deployed_main.
runtime_generation.previous_test_fixture_gap: tests/test_real_agent_benchmark_retry4.py used MINIMAL_RETRY2_SOURCE, which contained the legacy import but none of the DoctorAgent or MetaAgent validate_prediction call sites.

canonical.name: validate_prediction_response
canonical.return_type: Validated dictionary containing exactly risk_probability, prediction, and reasoning_summary
exceptions: ResponseContractError for field, type, range, Markdown, privacy-token, and other contract violations
ReasoningSummaryLengthError when reasoning_summary exceeds 640 Unicode characters

legacy_compatibility_wrapper.name: validate_prediction
legacy_compatibility_wrapper.semantics: Delegates directly to validate_prediction_response; it does not contain a second validation implementation.

root_cause.generator_change: scripts/run_real_agent_benchmark_retry4.py replaces the retry2 import of PREDICTION_SCHEMA and validate_prediction with canonical agent_response_contract imports.
root_cause.omission: The generator did not replace the three legacy validate_prediction call-site identifiers and did not define a compatibility alias in generated scope.
root_cause.effect: Generated source compiled, loaded Qwen, then each run_one invocation raised NameError before client.chat was called.

additional_runtime_only_finding.finding: The generated result privacy scan inspected its own audit key test_metrics_provided=false and matched the prohibited substring test_metric.
additional_runtime_only_finding.effect: After the validator NameError was fixed, otherwise successful synthetic integration results would have failed the privacy gate because of a false positive in audit metadata.
additional_runtime_only_finding.resolution: The negative audit metadata key is rendered as evaluation_metrics_provided=false. The prohibited-token scan itself is unchanged and no privacy rule is weakened.

recommended_fix.strategy: Replace the three legacy generated call sites with validate_prediction_response while retaining one canonical implementation.
recommended_fix.reason: Only three explicit generated call sites require repair. A new alias in generated scope would hide future missed transformations, whereas guarded replacement makes the deployment contract explicit and fail-fast.
must_not_change: model parameters, sample selection, expert probabilities, and KB content
